description:
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing an Angel.
Bishop of Wings triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
The Spirit enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade and Blasting Station.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
The Spirit token becomes a 4/4 Spirit Angel due to having a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 3, untapping itself.
Resolve Blasting Station's remaining ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Spirit token.
Repeat from step 2.
